name: Codebase Investigator
description: Debugs codebase issues by detecting errors, analyzing files, and suggesting causes.

problemDescription.description: Description of the problem to investigate.

analysisReport.description: Report detailing the investigation findings and suggested solutions.

steps: Collect a detailed description of the bug, error messages, and relevant files.
Trace through the related files and logs to identify suspicious code regions or dependencies.
Document the suspected root cause, required fixes, and any testing steps.
